# Card art: extra sheets (generated by `pnpm cardprompts:extra`)

Cards that were added after the main sheets, or that the main tool skips. Paste ONE prompt, attach the Valeria image (`Sunlit Paladin with Shield and Sword.png`), and save the result as `assets-src/cards/<sheet name>.png`. Then tell me, and I cut it.

## Sheet `extra-01` (6 pictures)

```
Create ONE ILLUSTRATION SHEET of 6 separate card-art pictures for a card-battler game (like Slay the Spire), 2400 x 1800, no text.
The attached image (Valeria) is the STYLE ANCHOR: match its cartoon game-art rendering exactly (bold clean dark outlines, flat saturated colours, simple cel shading, crisp polished shapes). Do NOT copy her character; paint scenes and objects. Backgrounds are softer and less contrasty than the main subject so the subject pops.

LAYOUT (critical): a clean 3 x 3 grid of landscape 4:3 pictures (each about 760 x 570), separated by thin flat dark navy (#14181f) gutters, with NO frames, NO borders, NO captions, NO text, NO numbers. Every picture fills its own cell completely; nothing crosses a gutter. Each picture has ONE clear subject in the middle that reads at thumbnail size, a simple scene behind it, light from the upper left. Leave any unused cells plain dark navy.

WORLD: each picture has its own world, given in [brackets] after it; paint that picture in that world. Do not write the brackets.

THE PICTURES, in this exact order, left to right, top row first. Use the card name and its effect only to decide what to draw; never write the name:
1. "Joker's Gambit" (skill): Unplayable. If discarded: Add 3 Sleeve Knives to your hand. Show a grinning joker card thrown to the floor and blossoming into three glowing teal knives. A little more dramatic and detailed. [World: Sylas, a flamboyant rogue throwing teal-glowing knives; a moonlit ballroom of shadows: violet and teal mist, masks, mirrors, candelabras.]
2. "Purging Light" (skill): Dispel every debuff on you. Gain 8 Barrier. Consume. Show a pillar of white-gold light washing dark chains and curse-smoke off a kneeling silhouette, bright and clean. A little more dramatic and detailed. [World: the shattered rift between worlds: violet and cyan energy, floating broken stone.]
3. "Ace Up the Sleeve" (skill): Unplayable. If discarded: Draw 2 cards. Show a playing card flicked out of a sleeve with a flourish, caught mid-flip, a sly grin in the shadows. [World: Sylas, a flamboyant rogue throwing teal-glowing knives; a moonlit ballroom of shadows: violet and teal mist, masks, mirrors, candelabras.]
4. "Loaded Die" (skill): Unplayable. If discarded: Deal 6 damage to ALL enemies. Show a heavy weighted die tumbling across a table and bursting into a ring of teal sparks. [World: Sylas, a flamboyant rogue throwing teal-glowing knives; a moonlit ballroom of shadows: violet and teal mist, masks, mirrors, candelabras.]
5. "Pilfered Time" (skill): Unplayable. If discarded: Gain 1 Mana. Show a stolen pocket watch dangling from nimble fingers, its hands blurred, sand of time spilling. [World: Sylas, a flamboyant rogue throwing teal-glowing knives; a moonlit ballroom of shadows: violet and teal mist, masks, mirrors, candelabras.]
6. "Steady Nerves" (skill): Lessen every debuff on you by 2. Gain 6 Barrier. Show a calm steady hand held out, a deep breath, dark jittery mist fading from it into clear air. [World: the shattered rift between worlds: violet and cyan energy, floating broken stone.]

NEGATIVE: text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, UI, card frames, borders, watermark, logo, photorealism, gritty texture, nudity, characters facing away.
```
